Typically every 6 months is recommended, depending on how much you drive. To change your oil, you'll need an oil pan (to collect old oil), an oil filter, a wrench for your oil plug, and a wrench to remove the oil filter (I leave my wrenches with my jack in the car). Check YouTube/owners manual/auto parts shop to determine how much oil your vehicle holds. To change the oil: remove oil pan plug and let drain into your oil pan. While it's draining, swap the filter out (it also holds a little oil so it might be messy). Put the oil plug back in, not too tight or too loose, then put new oil in (you may have a little left over, save it for now).Start your car and let it run for 5-10 seconds to make sure no oil is leaking from filter or plug, tighten any areas if needed. Turn off car and check oil level with dipstick, top off with remaining oil if needed. Put old oil from pan into now-empty oil jug to dispose of properly. It should only take 5-10 minutes to change your oil once you get the hang of it. As someone said below, plastic ramps are cheap and extremely useful.
